breakpoints.name: board
breakpoints.purpose: The 56px rail, and the work pane beside the supervisor pane (--pane); tabs hidden; the Needs and Tasks heads shown; the separator present; the masthead row spans the page with 24px of padding.

breakpoints.name: below-board
breakpoints.purpose: Three tabs (Needs, Tasks, Chat), one panel at a time, panels held to 880px and 760px columns; the menu button opens the rail as a sheet; no resizing.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: 12px board padding; one-row masthead with the Needs count shown and the fleet id, model, queue, compactions and context bar hidden; the Interrupt label hidden; tabs in thirds.

breakpoints.name: app-shell
breakpoints.purpose: With body[data-page=fleet][data-shell]: the body fills 100dvh and never scrolls; the work pane and the timeline scroll inside themselves.

breakpoints.name: short
breakpoints.purpose: The page flows; a 36px sticky masthead merges the tabs into its row; the composer sticks to the bottom; the text box stops at 30dvh.

breakpoints.name: short-phone
breakpoints.purpose: The fleet name, model, queue and compactions hide from the masthead.

breakpoints.name: coarse-pointer
breakpoints.purpose: --control 44px; 16px inputs; 24px separator; 52px option rows; the send key hint hidden.

containers.name: rail
containers.purpose: The fixed navigation column from 900px; the page takes 56px of left padding.

containers.name: pane
containers.purpose: The supervisor pane's width; --chat is the remembered drag width (hand.chat in localStorage) and only --pane clamps it.

containers.name: work-column
containers.purpose: Needs and Tasks inside the work pane, padded 24px by 32px.

containers.name: chat-column
containers.purpose: The timeline and the composer inside the supervisor pane.

containers.name: thread
containers.purpose: Task, Tasks, decision, conversation, error and fleet-list pages; padding 20px 16px 48px; the masthead aligns to 848px (1120px and 1088px on the task page).

containers.name: two-line-row
containers.purpose: A collapsed Needs row takes two lines: the title, then the refs and time.

containers.name: operator-bubble
containers.purpose: The widest an operator bubble grows.

containers.name: composer-growth
containers.purpose: The text box stops at 40dvh in the shell, 30dvh on short screens and without JavaScript.

favicons.choice: blocked when the worst item is a blocked screen; attention when anything waits or the supervisor is blocked; working while it works; else plain
favicons.title: "(!) s1 blocked", "(n) fleet", "● fleet", or the fleet name

constraints.csp: script-src 'self'; one stylesheet and one script; no inline script, inline style or style attribute (TestNoInlineScriptOrStyle); app.js sets --chat and the rail tip's top through the CSSOM
constraints.fonts: system faces only; no @font-face and no url() in board.css (TestNoWebFonts)
constraints.liveUpdates: Server-Sent Events per region, polling when hidden or disconnected
constraints.withoutJs: all three panels show, the tabs are anchors, the rail links render, the separator is absent, forms post and redirect
constraints.contrast: 22 text pairs at 4.5:1 in both themes (TestColoursMeetContrast)
constraints.width: one remembered chat width; chat at least 360px, work pane at least 440px; no resizing below 900px

narrative.overview:
The fleet is run from an on-call board. Everything that needs the operator is an open item: a blocked screen, a failure, a decision or an unread report. Items are paged in one fixed severity order and grouped under one head per severity word, acknowledged in place, and resolved into the conversation. The operator opens the board and knows at once whether anything is paged, because the masthead pill and the Needs count answer before the page settles. They acknowledge the top item where it sits (press "2 No", pick an option on d5 and send it, mark r7 read), watch it collapse to its receipt while a Hand line lands in the conversation, and then read s1's reply and steer it from the composer.

The material is a quiet review palette: a white ground, pale grey cards and panels on hairline rules and near-black ink, with a charcoal night theme whose cards sit one step above the ground. Accent blue marks the operator's own bubble, focus, links, the picked option and the working pulse. Fail red is kept for trouble. Severity lives in pale header fills on bordered items, and every state carries a word and an icon shape as well as a colour. Type is the system sans at five sizes; mono is kept for refs, code, keys, terminal text, severity codes and live figures. The fleet tint touches only the mark and a 3px rule across the top.

The Board is built for one operator who works beside an editor or on a phone. Navigation is one slim rail of icons at the left edge, 56px wide, that names its items on hover, on focus or on request; below 900px the same list opens from the masthead as a sheet. At 900px and wider the fleet page is that rail and two panes. The work pane is the widest thing on the page and holds Needs in severity bands, then Tasks with its search field. The supervisor pane on the right holds the supervisor's controls, its conversation, set as replies on the pane and the operator's bubbles, and a slim composer. A separator between the panes is dragged to size the chat: one remembered width for the whole board, never under 360px for the chat or 440px for the work pane, and no resizing below 900px, where three tabs (Needs, Tasks and Chat) show one panel at a time. A decision is answered from a choice list in Needs or on its page. From the Board, things (a task, a report, a decision, a deliverable) open in a new tab and places (the rail, a crumb, a pager step) navigate in place, so the Board stays where the operator left it. Every page shows one fleet; the Tasks page searches all of its tasks. The Board refuses a text sidebar with a conversation and an inspector beside it, and it refuses the green-on-black terminal opposite.
keyCharacteristics: A white ground (`bg`) with pale grey cards (`card`) on hairlines (`line`) by day, and `#111317` with cards raised to `#1b1f25` at night.
A 56px icon rail and two panes from 900px, three tabs and a sheet below it: the work pane stays the widest thing on the page, and the chat is dragged to a remembered width inside fixed limits.
One severity ramp orders Needs into bands, fills the open item's header, and colours the band heads and the Needs counts.
Every state is a word plus an icon shape plus a colour, never colour alone.

The conversation is not a stack of cards: the supervisor's replies sit on the pane under a head line, the operator's messages are accent-bg bubbles on the right, and Hand's own events are one-line ringed notes.
A decision is a choice list: numbered options with their consequences, one marked recommended, and a note.
Acknowledge in place: a pressed key collapses its item to "Sent 2 · waiting…", and every action leaves a receipt, a Hand line and a link back.
Things open in a new tab and places in place; the composer's draft survives either.
A 44px masthead that answers the supervisor's state, model and context window.
Five type sizes, tabular numerals for live figures, no web fonts, and a strict CSP.

rules.name: The Red Is Trouble Rule
rules.body: Fail red marks only what blocks or has broken: a blocked screen, a failure, an interrupted or unreachable supervisor, a context window at 90%, the auto-deny countdown and an error, plus the two controls that end a turn. Decisions, reports, links and ordinary states never take it.

rules.name: The Word And Shape Rule
rules.body: A state is never colour alone. The masthead pill carries an icon and a word, each Needs band head carries the severity word and each Needs row its icon, and each task row carries its state icon.

rules.name: The Tint Stays Put Rule
rules.body: The fleet tint colours the mark and the masthead's 3px top rule. It never fills a surface or colours copy.

rules.name: The Five Sizes Rule
rules.body: Every pixel font size is 22, 18, 15, 14 or 12px. `TestTypeHasFiveSteps` fails on any other, with one pinned exception: inputs rise to 16px on coarse pointers so a phone never zooms. Inline code in replies sets at 12px.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Figures that update in place are set in tabular numerals so the row never shifts: the `.live` class (the context figure, the countdown), every `time`, counts, meta and refs.

rules.name: The Two Panes At Board Width Rule
rules.body: The work pane and the supervisor pane sit side by side from 900px (`TestNeedsAndTasksSitBesideTheChatAtBoardWidth`); below it the three tabs stay and the separator is absent (`TestTabsBelowBoardWidth`).

rules.name: The Chat Width Clamp Rule
rules.body: The chat's width is the custom property `--chat`, and only `--pane` turns it into a grid track, clamped to 360px at least and everything but 440px at most. `app.js` sets `--chat` through the CSSOM, which the CSP allows, and never lays the pane out itself (`TestTheChatPaneResizesInsideTheClamp`).

rules.name: The Slim Rail Rule
rules.body: Navigation is a 56px rail of icons from 900px and a sheet below it; the work pane stays the widest thing on the page, so there is no text sidebar, and the chat is dragged to size with no fold or widen mode (`TestThePhoneSheetHoldsTheRailsLinks`, `TestTheRailIsSixTabStopsBeforeTheMasthead`).

rules.name: The Proven Fleets Rule
rules.body: The rail lists the current fleet and, beside it, only the fleets whose login the browser sends and that fleet accepts. A fleet the browser holds no valid token for never has its name in the page, and no fleet's Needs count shows in another's rail. A network board lists only its own fleet (`TestTheRailListsOnlyTheFleetsTheViewerCanProve`, `TestTheCurrentFleetIsAlwaysListed`, `TestANetworkBoardListsOnlyItsOwnFleet`, `TestTheRailListsOnlyFleetsTheBrowserHoldsALiveTokenFor`).

rules.name: The Five Regions Rule
rules.body: The fleet page updates live through exactly five regions, `status`, `console`, `timeline`, `queue` and `tasks`, and the composer form sits outside every region so a live update never takes the operator's draft. The console region sits in the supervisor pane's head, and the task search form sits in the Tasks head outside the tasks region, for the same reason.

rules.name: The Things In New Tabs Rule
rules.body: From the Board, things open in a new tab and places navigate in place; outside links always open in a new tab. A thing is a task, attempt, report, decision, deliverable, image or outside page; a place is a fleet, the Board, Tasks, Conversation, a crumb, a pager step or an anchor. The fleet page's task rows, Needs links and refs in replies and Hand lines carry `target="_blank" rel="noopener"` (`TestAwayOpensLiveRefsInANewTab`); the Tasks page, the conversation page and the thread pages browse refs in place (`TestTheTasksPageBrowsesInPlace`, `TestTheLogAndThreadPagesKeepRefsInPlace`). Middle-click and Ctrl-click work everywhere.

rules.name: The Flat Board Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces carry a hairline and no shadow. `TestTheOnCallPalette` fails on any `box-shadow` outside the composer box, the menus, the toast, the keys and `kbd`.

rules.name: The Bands Rule
rules.body: Needs groups its open items under one head per severity word, most severe first, and the head carries the word and its tone, so a row repeats neither. A collapsed row is one calm line and only the open item is a card.

rules.name: The One Choice List Rule
rules.body: A decision is answered from one component, the choice list, in a Needs item and on the decision page, and the answered state is the same list at rest. The question never repeats its option lines, and the server joins the pick and the note into one answer.

rules.name: The One Badge And One Row Rule
rules.body: Every pill, count and tag is the one `.badge`, and every line of the task, attempt, event, decision and fleet lists is the one `.row`. A new component sets a slot or a tone on them; it never draws a third shape.

dos: **Do** take every colour from the custom properties in `board.css` (`var(--fail)`, `var(--accent-bg)`), and give any new token both a light and a dark value that keeps 4.5:1 for text.
**Do** order anything that needs the operator by the severity ramp in `internal/board/queue.go`, group it under one head per severity word, and fill the open item's header with its tone's pale fill.
**Do** give every state a word and an icon shape as well as its colour.
**Do** keep font sizes to 22, 18, 15, 14 and 12px, and set figures that update in place in tabular numerals.
**Do** leave a trace for every action: a receipt, a Hand line in Chat, and a link back to the item.
**Do** keep one primary button per form, and keep Stop behind a second press.

**Do** keep all style in `board.css` and all script in `app.js`: no inline script, no inline style and no `style` attribute. `app.js` may set the `--chat` custom property and the rail tip's `top` through the CSSOM, which the CSP allows.
**Do** stop every animation under `prefers-reduced-motion`: the working pulse, the feed, the arrival wash and the open and close transition.
donts: **Don't** use fail red for decisions, reports, links or ordinary states.
**Don't** put a shadow on a resting surface; only the open menus and the toast lift.
**Don't** colour copy or fill a surface with the fleet tint.
**Don't** bring back the newsroom words (WIRE, FLASH, BULLETIN, URGENT, ROUTINE, SERVICE, dispatch, news budget, tray) or the canary, carbon, ink band, `h-*` and `pencil` tokens.
**Don't** load web fonts or images from the stylesheet.
**Don't** draw an icon as a text glyph or pull in an icon library; add it to `icons.html` in the 16px, 1.5-stroke family.
**Don't** show both panes below 900px or resize anything there, and don't switch tabs for the operator.

**Don't** add a text sidebar or a third column beside the two panes. Navigation is the 56px icon rail, its names showing on hover, on focus or on request, and the work pane stays the widest thing on the page. Don't make a green-on-black terminal look beyond the screen excerpt.
**Don't** list a fleet in the rail, or show its name or count anywhere in a page, unless the browser holds a valid token for it.
